inputs: Observed PS-0241 activity-chain snapshot, validated DAG and fresh observed routes

optimization.forecast_duration: upper_minutes + observed admitted travel upper minutes
hard_constraints: upfront debit and modeled completion preserve the canonical household reserve, or do not deepen a shortfall
no cheating, irreversible actions or ambiguous permissions
optimization.lagrange: User-provided nonnegative shadow prices weight soft tradeoffs but never relax hard invariants
optimization.kkt: Continuous concave log utility time allocation only; discrete actions use feasibility filtering and bounded search
optimization.Gaussian_process: Not required; PS-0241 optional provenance-isolated duration GP remains a separate advisory comparator

wealth_policy.transition: Debit verified cost first. Apply outcome delta on success, bounded by the existing game cap. Cost is sunk on failure; reobserve after failure.
wealth_policy.extra_loss_penalty: 0.05 * max(0, balance_before - balance_after) * (1 + max(0, 1 - surplus_after / (0.1 * reserve)))
wealth_policy.calibration: Initial policy values, not empirical weights. Regular monetary utility rewards positive realized headroom. Shadow prices cannot disable the reserve or loss premium.

integration.downstream: future same-version EA-native consumer only after exact patch and game certification

evidence: Source-only simulation fixtures are not observed Sims gameplay, runtime fitness, or statistical calibration
